chunks: He is the One who created for you all that is in the earth; then He turned to the heaven and fashioned it seven heavens, and He is Knower of everything.
ai.seo_question: What is the sequence of creation described in Surah Al-Baqarah regarding the earth and the heavens?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to establish the hierarchy of creation, where the earth serves as the foundation for human life before the cosmos is perfected. The phrase 'He it is Who created for you all that is in the earth' underscores Allah's providence (Rizq) and the purposeful design of the material world, while the subsequent ascent to the heavens highlights the divine order (Tawhid) and omniscience that governs both the microcosm and macrocosm.
